scenarios.name: mixed_concurrent_llm_and_vision
scenarios.description: 4 concurrent heterogeneous jobs (I/O-bound LLM, decode-heavy vision, transform-heavy audio, stochastic-aug vision) sharing one bounded cache

scenarios.name: cpu_bottlenecked_heavy_decode
scenarios.description: Fast storage with CPU decode/transform saturating host cores across 3 concurrent jobs (2 sharing a public vision dataset + 1 private heavy-transform audio job)

scenarios.name: tight_ram_high_expansion
scenarios.description: High decoded memory expansion (>=6x over encoded) under tight RAM (~90% of encoded working set, ~12% of decoded working set) with slow S3 object storage

scenarios.name: single_epoch_streaming_no_reuse
scenarios.description: Explicit Negative Regime: 1-epoch web-scale streaming corpus (working_set > 14x cache, zero sample reuse) where caching yields 0% hit rate
